Then @invideo.io Agent One dropped 🎯 and I built my personal AI crew. A Brand Strategist who locks the positioning. An Art Director who defines the mood. A DP who builds the shot list. A QA reviewer who validates every output against my brand rules.

I drop one brief in the chat ⚡ and the four agents ideate in parallel, run my brand world across every shot, ship the final cut from one canvas.

A model ships shots. Agent One ships entire productions.
